audit.unmatched_error: ⚠️ {n} real-squad player(s) had NO confident name match in the candidate pool — this audit is comparing against an INCOMPLETE ground truth: {names}
audit.verdict_error: 🔴 **The DSSScore-based top-26 selection is NOT statistically distinguishable from a random draw of 26 out of 49** (p={pvalue}, needs < 0.05 to claim real skill). This is a single real-world validation point (n=1 coach decision), heavily confounded by a mid-cycle coaching change (Regragui → Ouahbi, 2026-03-05) the scoring formula was never tuned against. It does not *prove* the formula is wrong, but it is the only real evidence this project has, and it is not supportive.
